user_saw: After last browsing Favorites, users with an unstarred model selected saw that model’s provider tab when they reopened the picker.
summary: The model picker now reopens on Favorites if it was the last tab chosen and is still available, even when the selected model is unstarred.
reasoning: PR #199051 introduced the remembered Favorites tab with an explicit test requiring the picker to reopen on the selected model’s provider when that model was unstarred. The intervening favorites reorder kept that rule in place, and this fix changed the expected behavior in both the test and the documentation.
